title: cotyledon persica
intro: Cotyledon persica, commonly known as Orpine or Houseleek, is a succulent plant belonging to the Crassulaceae family. It has been traditionally used for its medicinal properties, offering several health benefits such as wound healing, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial activities. The therapeutic actions of Cotyledon persica include its ability to soothe skin irritations, reduce fever, and even exhibit antiviral properties. The bioactive constituents responsible for these effects include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and triterpenoids, which are present in the plant's leaves and flowers.
